data: Which line represents the validation loss for the model without augmentation on the AG News dataset?

The question asks which line represents the validation loss for the model without augmentation on the AG News dataset. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the effect of overfitting on a DNN model through cross-entropy loss for two datasets: AG News and Sentiment 140. The figure is divided into two subfigures: (a) AG News - DNN Loss and (b) Sentiment 140 - DNN Loss. 

In subfigure (a), there are multiple lines representing different augmentation methods. The legend indicates that the black dashed line corresponds to "No Augmentation." Therefore, the black dashed line in subfigure (a) represents the validation loss for the model without augmentation on the AG News dataset.
